info.name: Otto AI Backend v2
info.description:
API collection for Otto AI Backend - AI-powered Revenue Intelligence Platform

**Authentication Modes:**
- **DEV Mode (APP_ENV=DEV)**: No JWT token required - all requests work without authentication. Leave bearer_token empty or remove Authorization headers. The backend will automatically use a mock user.
- **PROD Mode (APP_ENV=PROD)**: JWT token required - set bearer_token variable with a valid Clerk JWT token. All protected endpoints require authentication.

**Note:** Individual requests have auth configured, but in DEV mode the backend ignores it and uses mock authentication. You can remove auth from requests in DEV mode if preferred.

See README.md for detailed authentication setup instructions.

request.description:
Get booking rate improvement metrics (dual-period chart mode).

Returns per-day booking rate percentage for two periods for chart comparison.

Booking rate % per day = (booked leads / qualified leads) Ã— 100
- Booked leads: status='qualified_booked' OR deal_status='booked'
- Qualified leads: status IN ['qualified_booked', 'qualified_unbooked']

Response structure:
- period_a.series[]: [{x: date, y: booking_rate_%}, ...]
- period_a.average_booking_rate: avg of daily rates (%)
- period_b: same structure
- x_axis: ['periodA_date/periodB_date', ...]
- y_axis: percentage ticks [0.0, 20.0, 40.0, ...]

header.description: Company UUID (required if call record doesn't exist yet)

request.description:
Webhook for Shoonya AI job completion (new format with URLs). The handler fetches the complete call summary from Shoonya's Summary API using the call_id. No authentication required.

Required fields:
- `status`: Must be "completed" to be processed
- `call_id`: UUID of the call record

Optional fields:
- `job_id`: Shoonya job identifier
- `event_type`: Type of processing event
- `company_id`: Required if the call record doesn't already exist in the database
- `summary_url`, `chunks_url`: Reference URLs (actual data is fetched from Shoonya API)
Webhook for Shoonya AI job completion (legacy format with results object containing URLs). No authentication required.
Webhook for Shoonya AI job completion (legacy format with full result data inline). Used as fallback when Shoonya Summary API is unavailable. No authentication required.

header.description: RSA-SHA256 webhook signature from GHL for authenticity verification

request.description:
Webhook for GoHighLevel contact creation. No authentication required.

Supported event types:
- ContactCreate, ContactUpdate, ContactDelete, ContactTagUpdate
- AppointmentCreate, AppointmentUpdate, AppointmentDelete
- OpportunityCreate, OpportunityUpdate, OpportunityDelete
- OpportunityStatusUpdate, OpportunityStageUpdate
- OpportunityMonetaryValueUpdate, OpportunityAssignedToUpdate

Required fields:
- `type` (or `eventType` or `name`): Event type string
- `locationId`: GHL location ID (used to resolve company)

Optional headers:
- `x-wh-signature`: RSA-SHA256 signature for webhook verification

header.description: RSA-SHA256 webhook signature from GHL for authenticity verification

request.description:
Webhook for GoHighLevel appointment creation. No authentication required.

Appointment fields:
- `id`: GHL appointment ID
- `contactId`: Associated contact ID
- `startTime`, `endTime`: ISO 8601 timestamps
- `appointmentStatus`: "confirmed", "completed", or "cancelled"
- `calendarId`: Calendar identifier
- `address`: Location address
- `notes`: Appointment notes
- `assignedUserId`: GHL user ID assigned to the appointment

Webhook for GoHighLevel opportunity/lead creation. No authentication required.

Opportunity fields:

header.description: RSA-SHA256 webhook signature from GHL for authenticity verification

request.description:
Webhook for GoHighLevel inbound call messages. No authentication required.

Processes call events with messageType=CALL. Fetches call recordings from GHL API or Twilio attachment URLs and uploads them to S3.

Call event fields:
- `messageType`: Must be "CALL" for call processing
- `direction`: "inbound" or "incoming"
- `status`: "completed" or "answered" (others are ignored)
- `contactId`: GHL contact ID
- `messageId`: GHL message ID (used to fetch recording)
- `locationId`: GHL location ID (used to resolve company)
- `userId`: GHL user ID (rep who handled the call)
- `from`: Caller phone number
- `to`: Recipient phone number
- `dateAdded`: Timestamp of the call
- `callDuration` or `duration`: Call duration in seconds
- `attachments`: Array of recording URLs (e.g., Twilio URLs)

Non-CALL messages are acknowledged with 200 OK without processing.

header.description: RSA-SHA256 webhook signature from GHL for authenticity verification

request.description:
Webhook for GoHighLevel outbound call messages from GHL workflows. No authentication required.

Outbound webhooks may use alternative field names that are normalized:
- `callDirection` -> `direction`
- `callFrom` -> `from`
- `callTo` -> `to`
- `callStatus` -> `status`

For outbound calls, the contact is the recipient (to field).

header.description: Request timestamp used in signature computation

request.description:
Webhook for Call Tracking Metrics inbound calls. No authentication required.

Only processes calls with status "completed" or "answered" - others are ignored.

Required fields:
- `id`: CTM call ID (integer)
- `account_id`: CTM account ID (used to resolve company)
- `direction`: "inbound" or "outbound"
- `status`: "answered" or "completed"
- `caller_number` or `caller_number_bare`: Caller phone number

Recording:
- `audio`: URL to the call recording (downloaded and stored in S3)

Optional headers:
- `X-CTM-Signature`: HMAC-SHA1 signature for verification
- `X-CTM-Time`: Timestamp used in signature computation

The full raw payload is preserved in `extra_metadata.ctm_raw_payload` for debugging.

header.description: Request timestamp used in signature computation

request.description:
Webhook for Call Tracking Metrics outbound calls. No authentication required.

For outbound calls:
- `dialed_number` or `destination_number`: The destination phone number
- `agent_email` or `agent.email`: Agent who made the call (used to look up user)
- `caller_number`: Company's outbound number

Only processes calls with status "completed" or "answered".
